name: Web Summit 2026
notes: Lisbon, Portugal (MEO/Altice Arena + FIL). Opening night 9 Nov. Big stage for AI startup and martech narratives; good hook for AI-in-marketing takes.

name: AWS re:Invent 2026
notes: Las Vegas, NV (multiple Strip venues). Major gen-AI/agentic cloud launches that shape the AI stack marketers build on.

name: NeurIPS 2026
notes: Main site Sydney, Australia (6-12 Dec); satellites Atlanta and Paris 9-13 Dec per neurips.cc homepage. Top AI research conference; source of frontier-model trend content.

name: CES 2027
notes: Las Vegas, NV (LVCC and other venues); media days start a few days earlier. Sets the year's consumer-AI narrative that D2C brands ride.

name: Effie India Awards (26th edition)
notes: Mumbai (The Advertising Club). 2027 date not announced; previous galas 24 Jan 2025 (24th) and ~13 Feb 2026 at Taj Lands' End (25th). India's marketing-effectiveness benchmark; ideal for ROI/effectiveness content.

name: Nasscom Technology & Leadership Forum (NTLF) 2027
notes: Likely Mumbai. 2027 dates not announced; past editions 20-21 Feb 2024 (Jio World Centre) and 24-25 Feb 2025 (Grand Hyatt Mumbai). Nasscom's flagship tech forum with a heavy AI agenda for Indian enterprise.

name: IAMAI India Digital Summit 2027
notes: Leela Bharatiya City, Bengaluru. Live IAMAI pages show 11-12 Feb 2027; older search-index snapshots of IAMAI showed 29-30 Jan 2027, and no independent press yet, so re-check. 2026 edition (20th) was 29-30 Jan. India's top digital-ecosystem summit; core D2C/CMO audience.

name: NVIDIA GTC 2027
notes: San Jose McEnery Convention Center, San Jose, CA. Official FAQ says 14-18 Mar (14 = pre-conference day); homepage banner and CFP page say 15-18 Mar core. Keynote drives the AI infra/agent news cycle.

name: Google Cloud Next 2027
notes: Mandalay Bay Convention Center, Las Vegas (select programming 12 Apr). Gemini/agent launches for enterprise marketing and analytics.

name: Goafest 2027 (incl. ABBY Awards)
notes: Goa (AAAI + The Advertising Club). Not announced; 2026 was 20-22 May, 2025 21-23 May, 2024 29-31 May. India's biggest ad festival; ABBYs set creative benchmarks.

name: Google I/O 2027
notes: Likely Shoreline Amphitheatre, Mountain View. Not announced; 2026 was 19-20 May. Gemini/Search AI changes directly affect SEO and ads.

name: Google Marketing Live 2027
notes: Virtual/livestream. Not announced; 2026 was 20 May (EMEA 21 May). Most important AI-ads product event for performance marketers.

name: Microsoft Build 2027
notes: Venue TBA (2026 was Fort Mason, San Francisco, 2-3 Jun; 2025 Seattle, 19-22 May) - could be June. Copilot/agent platform news.

name: Social Media Week 2027
notes: Metropolitan Pavilion, New York (Adweek). Dates only from Social Media Today; official page shows venue but no dates. 2026 was 14-16 Apr. Social/creator marketing trends.

name: Web Summit Vancouver 2027
notes: Vancouver, Canada (Vancouver Convention Centre in prior years; tagged US as nearest North America region). Startup/AI stage for North American audience.

name: Apple WWDC 2027
notes: Apple Park, Cupertino + online. Not announced; 2026 was 8-12 Jun. Apple Intelligence and privacy changes affect mobile attribution and app marketing.

name: Cannes Lions 2027
notes: Palais des Festivals, Cannes, France (74th edition). Global creativity benchmark; AI-in-creative is now a dominant theme.

name: Geneva AI Summit 2027 (successor to India AI Impact Summit)
notes: Palexpo, Geneva, Switzerland; co-chaired with UAE (host 2028). Global AI-governance summit following India's Feb 2026 summit; India-angle policy content.

name: AI Appreciation Day
notes: Fixed annual observance (16 Jul, since 2021); informal/marketing-driven but covered by IndiaAI and Indian business press. Natural brand-moment post.

name: ICML 2027
notes: Riocentro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Expo 31 Jul, tutorials 1 Aug, main conference 2-4 Aug, workshops 5-6 Aug. Top ML research venue.

name: LIONS Asia 2027 (formerly Spikes Asia)
notes: Singapore, September 2027 (month reported, days not announced; single source). Spikes Asia rebrands to LIONS Asia Festival of Creativity + Asia Lions Awards. APAC creative benchmark incl. India.

name: Meta Connect 2027
notes: Meta HQ, Menlo Park, CA + online. Not announced; 2026 was 23-24 Sep. Meta AI and ad-tooling news matter for D2C on Instagram/WhatsApp.

name: HubSpot UNBOUND 2027 (formerly INBOUND)
notes: Boston, MA. INBOUND renamed UNBOUND in 2026. Go-to-market/AI-CRM conference; B2B marketing hook.

name: DMEXCO 2027
notes: Koelnmesse, Cologne, Germany. Europe's leading digital-marketing/adtech expo; AI-ads and measurement themes.

name: Advertising Week New York 2027
notes: New York (2026 at The Penn District, 5-8 Oct; 2025 6-9 Oct). 2027 not announced. Major US ad-industry week.

name: OpenAI DevDay 2027
notes: Likely San Francisco. Not announced; 2026 was 29 Sep (Fort Mason), 2025 6 Oct, 2024 1 Oct. Model/API launches that power AI marketing tools.

name: Web Summit 2027
notes: Lisbon, Portugal. Dates shown on websummit.com only; second source only confirms Lisbon through 2028. Same AI/startup hook as the 2026 edition.
